The image depicts a simple scene dominated by geometric elements and primary colors. In the foreground is a pink sphere that seems to be the primary focus of the image. The sphere is perfectly round and is positioned slightly off-center to the left side of the image, placed on a flat, blue-colored surface which constitutes the ground. The blue surface extends horizontally across the image, providing a clear distinction between the ground and the background elements.

Above the blue surface is a broad yellow band that runs horizontally behind the sphere
